findings.title: Remove dead sext branches and unused variables from trampolines
findings.evidence: The fix hardcoded `let needs_sext = false;` and `let buf_elem_llvm_ty = elem_llvm_ty;` but left 5 downstream `if needs_sext { ... } else { ... }` branches across all trampoline map/filter/fold variants. The plan explicitly instructed to simplify trampolines: 'The needs_sext flag and buf_elem_llvm_ty vs elem_llvm_ty distinction become unnecessary. Simplify to always use canonical types'.
findings.impact: BLOAT/WASTE. Unused complexity and dead branches left in a hot codegen path, violating the cleanup rule.
findings.required_plan_update: Add a task to `fix-BUG-04-071.md` (or a followup hygiene pass) to physically remove `needs_sext`, `buf_elem_llvm_ty`, and their associated `if/else` sext emission branches from `trampolines.rs`.
